counting_rules.depth: depth = REGION_TYPES 祖先个数（Module 不计）；d1 = 0/1，d2 = 2，d3plus = >= 3；宿主只允许 depth >= inherent(host)
counting_rules.host: host = 节点的直接父节点 + 该节点在父节点中的槽位唯一决定（host_of()）
counting_rules.variant: variant = 该形态族的语义变体槽；每槽由一个 AST 谓词判定（谓词源码在生成器内）
counting_rules.cell: 条目 = (form, variant, host, depth)；族内按 variant 声明序 × 宿主声明序 × 深度档序展开
counting_rules.structural: 结构性单元 = 该 (form,variant,host) 在证据索引中无任何观测时登记 1 条（深度取该宿主最小档）；每族最多登记 structural_cap 条，整族零证据时不截断
counting_rules.c1c5: C1 = p_j/p_j_sha256/p_j_lines; C2 = pyc/pyc_sha256/pyc_loadable; C3/C4/C5 must come from an external evidence record; missing means not covered_5tuple.
